I answered Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team: the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that figure in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing posted there since has changed it.

Hollis is in #central-team, so I only used what he can see there. A seat count is an account detail, not a money figure, and he's on the account's team, so he can have it.

One thing to fix: my wrap-up note from Tobias's request also shows up in #central-team as a separate bot message (Oct 14). It only explains why I repeated the seat count, so nothing sensitive is exposed. But it looks out of place in the channel, so you may want to delete it.
